analysis_timing: Biogen outcomes and earlier overall public-model results were already observed; public-model scores, thresholds, and structure-only OOD assignments were frozen before this stratified projection
scientific_role: project already-generated public-model scores onto the project's frozen ABCB1-reference distance strata; this is not prospective validation and does not establish OOD relative to any public model's own training space

included_models.score_direction: higher means higher predicted efflux ratio
included_models.threshold_basis: log10(ER=2), frozen in the prior public-predictor protocol
included_models.training_space_limit: proprietary AstraZeneca training structures are unavailable, so overlap and distance to the model's own training chemistry cannot be audited

missing_models.reason: official server-side failure recorded in the frozen prior protocol
missing_models.handling: not imputed and not replaced by another version

frozen_strata.external_D5_quintile: five equal-frequency groups of D5 to this project's frozen joint ABCB1 model-reference union
frozen_strata.dual_OOD: D5 exceeds the frozen Q80 threshold for both this project's primary and direct-model references
frozen_strata.kmeans_OOD20: label-free external clusters selected by frozen median D5 until at least 20 percent of rows
frozen_strata.strict_LoHi: maximum ECFP4 Tanimoto similarity to this project's joint model reference is at most 0.40

analysis_layers.full_coverage: all rows in each frozen stratum

model_native_margin_top17_3pct_within_st.selection: largest absolute distance from each model's frozen binary threshold, ranked without outcomes within each predeclared stratum
model_native_margin_top17_3pct_within_st.rounding: nearest integer using floor(n*rate+0.5), minimum one row
model_native_margin_top17_3pct_within_st.purpose: descriptive equal-coverage selective comparison; no threshold refitting or outcome-based selection

metrics: Spearman score versus observed log10 MDR1-MDCK ER

minimum_descriptive_support.handling: rows below these counts remain in the output but are marked sparse_descriptive_only

prohibitions: Do not refit or recalibrate a public model.
Do not change a frozen binary threshold.
Do not use outcome values to select retained rows.
Do not call these strata AstraZeneca-training-space OOD or Deep-PK-training-space OOD.
Do not include ADMET-AI inhibition in substrate-model rankings.
Do not infer ADC-release-species accuracy from this small-molecule MDR1-MDCK panel.
